title: Repost: young elephant and a tree trunk

scenes.body: Asian elephants have one finger-like tip on the trunk that helps with precision.

scenes.headline: Filmed by Cherubino at Pinnawala, Sri Lanka
scenes.body: A managed orphanage herd, not wild elephants. Licence: CC BY-SA 3.0.

caption:
One finger, 150,000 muscle units.

The trunk has about 150,000 muscle units and tendons, arranged so it can move in any direction.

Source: Smithsonian's National Zoo.  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
